email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoBasalin patient with a mild skin rash
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a staff pharmacist at Demo Regional Hospital (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 30-year-old male patient with a history of type 2 diabetes received their fourth dose of DemoBasalin (dose: 10 mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-05-25.
Approximately 5 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed a mild skin rash.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
R. Haddad (fictional reporter)
Demo Regional Hospital
Contact: demo.reporter726@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
